It proposes an architecture of smart energy consumption system from field metering, communication, SCADA monitoring, storing in database, to predicting and forecasting

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Proposes a smart energy management system architecture (smart meters, SCADA, database, ML) and gives a comparative review of energy-consumption prediction/forecasting models for the mining industry. ISO 50001 and energy KPIs are invoked only at the management-system level; no EnPI/EnB performance-measurement model is identified or characterised (no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). EnPI/EnB content is incidental, and the paper is a framework/architecture proposal without measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: It proposes an architecture of smart energy consumption system

stage1.notes: Borderline: reviews ~30 consumption-prediction studies by algorithm only; proposed regression/NN is an architecture component, not a characterised EnPI/EnB model. Mining is out of Corpus-B scope.
